lines.li: [us] How long are you staying?
[them] As long as I need to, and not a day more.
[us] Anything worth buying?
[them] That depends what you're paying with.
[us] Silver, same as everyone.
[us] You don't trust us much, do you?
[them] I don't trust anyone much, it's kept me alive.
[us] Fair enough.
[us] Have I done something to upset you?
[them] You'd know if you had.
[us] Is everything to your liking?
[them] It is adequate, which is not a compliment.
[us] We'll try harder.
[us] Good day to you.
[them] Aye, if you say so.
[us] Is everything all right?
[them] Your words are many and your meaning is little.
[us] You'll want to get out of the rain.
[them] I'm fine where I am.
[us] Suit yourself.
[them] Not much here, is there?
[us] Enough for us.
[us] How's the war with {WAR} going?
[them] It's a war, how do you think it's going?
[us] How are things in {TOWN}?
[them] Fine, and none of your concern.
[them] You're new here, aren't you?
[us] Is it that obvious?
[them] You still smile at strangers.
[us] Your people have come at us, you know.
[them] I wasn't there.
[us] That's not much of an answer.
[them] Keep your {OURFAITH} to yourself, and we'll get on fine.
[us] Gladly.
[us] Can't sleep?
[them] Not with strangers about.
[us] We're the ones who live here.
[us] Any discount for neighbors?
[them] Not for you.
[them] You're short on food here, I hear.
[us] We'll manage.
[them] See that you do, I'm not sharing mine.
[them] Don't mind me, I'm only looking.
[us] Look all you like, from right there.
[them] Should I bow, or will a nod do?
[us] A nod will do.
[them] Good, my back's stiff.
[us] You're welcome here, {THEIRTITLE}.
[them] I'll decide for myself whether I'm welcome.
[us] I don't think we've met.
[them] No, and I'm not here to make friends.
[us] Then I'll leave you to it.
[us] Good to see you again.
[them] Is it?
[them] I heard you lost one of yours.
[us] We did.
[them] {WRONGNAME} died by your people's hands, in case you'd forgotten.
[us] I haven't.
[them] Did you want something?
[us] Just being neighborly.
[them] Be neighborly from a little farther off, then.
[us,cold] Cold enough for you?
[us,hot,!cold] Hot enough for you?
[them] I've had worse company than the weather.
[them] I'll miss this place when I go, you know.
[us] Then don't go yet.
[them] I have to, but I'll come back.
[us] We'll hold you to that.
[them] I'd be disappointed if you didn't.
[them] You've a way of making me laugh, {COLONIST}.
[us,trait:Abrasive] Nobody's ever said that to me before.
[us] It's easy with good company.
[them] Then we're both lucky today.
[them] Look at that sky.
[us] We get evenings like this now and then, it's the reward for the rest.
[them,their:tribal] My grandmother would say the sun is going home happy.
[them] I'd put up with a lot for an evening like this.
[us] So would I, and I do.
[them] Tell me something about this place nobody tells visitors.
[us] The best seat at supper is the one nearest the cook, and we fight for it.
[them] That's the truest thing I've heard all week.
[us] Your turn, then.
[them,their:tribal] Our elders snore louder than the drums, and we pretend not to hear.
[them] Half the gossip at home is made up, and the other half is worse.
[them] Do you know, I tell people at home about you.
[us] Good things?
[them] Mostly, and the rest I make sound good.
[us] That's what friends are for.
[them,their:tribal] Then you are a friend of the fire, and that is no small thing.
[them] Then you're a friend, and I don't say that often.
[them] What's the best part of your day here, {COLONIST}?
[us,skill:Cooking] When the first pot boils and everyone wanders in.
[us,skill:Plants] Early morning in the fields, before anyone needs me.
[us,skill:Animals] Feeding the animals, they're always glad to see me.
[us] Supper, when the work's done and nobody's hurt.
[them] That's a good answer.
[them] That meal we shared, I'd trade a lot for the recipe.
[us] It's a secret.
[them] Everything good is, out here.
